response.text: I'll start by verifying the key claims with set-based queries.

arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr, count(*) n from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by 1,2,3,4 having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT") order by 1

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where p."STAT_CD"='C' and (h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT" or h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT") order by 1

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."STAT_CD", (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') cr2000, (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') dr2000 from "APINVH" i where i."INV_AMT" <> coalesce((select sum("CR_AMT")-sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),0) order by 1

select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", c."ACTV_FLG", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") where c."ACCT_CD" is null or c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y' order by 1
